dashboardEmpty: Add a crop with its area to see an expected harvest.
disclaimer: Estimate based on {{district}} government yield statistics ({{years}}). A planning aid, not a prediction of your harvest.
evidenceCropNotSupported: We do not have reliable government yield records for this crop yet, so we will not show an estimate.
evidenceLookupUnavailable: The yield records could not be loaded right now. Please try again later.
evidenceNone: No government yield records were found for this crop in your area.
evidenceStateUnresolved: We could not match your farm's state to the government yield records.
factorEventNotApplied: A logged pest or disease is shown as a caution, not applied as a number. The published loss figures are annual averages that the district's own recorded yields already include, so subtracting them again would count the same loss twice.
factorIrrigationNotApplied: Irrigation is shown as a caution, not applied as a number. The district average already mixes irrigated and rainfed fields, and adjusting for yours would need the district's irrigated share, which we do not have.
factorsNoneApplied: No adjustment factors were applied. This estimate is the district's recorded yield multiplied by your area — nothing more.
insufficientBody: We only show an estimate when real government records exist for your crop, district and season. We would rather show nothing than a made-up number.
latestYearLabel: Most recent year in the records
limitFewObservations: Based on only {{n}} reported years, so the typical range is less certain.
limitHealthEvent: A crop health problem was logged on this crop recently. This estimate does not account for it.
limitIrrigationUnknown: Your field's water source is not recorded, and the district average mixes irrigated and rainfed fields.
limitNoSpread: The records do not show enough years to work out a typical range.
limitRainfed: Your field is rainfed. The district average includes irrigated fields, so your harvest may be lower.
limitVintage: The most recent government records are from {{latestYear}}, about {{years}} years ago.
limitationsHeading: What this does not account for
notAPrediction: This is arithmetic on published government records, not an AI prediction or a forecast.
pageSubtitle: What your district's recorded harvests suggest for your crops
productionAreaMissing: Add this crop's area to see an expected total harvest.
productionAreaUnitAmbiguous: A bigha is a different size in different states, so we will not convert it into a harvest total. Record this crop's area in acres or hectares to see one.
rangeTypicalYearToYear: This range is the district's normal year-to-year variation, not a confidence interval.
seasonFromRegistry: Season taken from the crop's known growing season.
seasonFromSowingMonth: Season worked out from your sowing date.
tierFallbackNote: We did not have records for {{requested}}, so this uses {{used}}.
unmatchedDistrict: We could not match "{{district}}" to a district in the government records, so this uses the state average instead.
